findings.source: abi.encodePacked(...) of a string/bytes in solc 0.7 (word copy with a masked last word)
findings.issue: The legacy packed-copy (whole words while at least 32 bytes remain, then a masked merge of the last partial word) is printed as a countdown while plus a long mask expression instead of one copy line.
findings.rule: A countdown word-copy loop followed by the masked tail merge copies exactly n bytes: print `mem[t len n] = mem[s len n]` (P7).

notes: Rocket Pool RocketMinipoolDelegate (old, solc 0.7.6). No explicit loop in the reached source; all 8 whiles are implicit bytes copies (packed encodes for the deposit contract call in stake/preDeposit and in close) (P7). Main flows (stake, refund, finalise, voteScrub, close, distributeBalance) reviewed by structure: storage reads/writes through RocketStorage calls, deposit contract call and events present; P2 lines are calls whose arguments are built from memory with a symbolic free pointer.
summary: Loop-free source with faithful text; the only notable noise is legacy bytes-copy loops and a few raw-memory call arguments.
